summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 3 new HRM modules (Attendance, Vacations, Evaluations). All 36 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend pages load correctly with all tabs and features working. Fixed route ordering bug in vacations.py where /calendar was being matched by /{vacation_id}.

fixed.issue: Route was returning 404 because it was defined after /{vacation_id} route, causing 'calendar' to be matched as vacation_id
fixed.fix: Moved /calendar route before /{vacation_id} route in vacations.py

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in FastAPI: Static routes like /calendar, /pending, /balance must be defined BEFORE dynamic routes like /{vacation_id} to avoid route conflicts
